**Ways back in** — none of them required; the loop may clear this itself.

- **Merge it by hand.** Close-out still ticks and closes the issue this branch names: it reads merged pull requests from GitHub and cannot tell whose hand pressed the button.
- **Push a commit.** The head moves, this record stops matching it, and the loop re-derives from scratch on the next pass.
- **Convert it to draft.** Draft is the hold gesture, and the loop stops seeing this pull request at all.

There is no override label. A push is both the fix and the re-engagement.
